name: Create a NEW Spider-Man character
prompt: Create a NEW Spider-Man character for a 2D game. Use the uploaded Captain America sprite as the visual style and proportion reference when attached: match its head-to-body ratio, clear torso, visible neck, distinct arms and legs, readable hands and boots, clean dark outlines, restrained shading and pixel density. Compact stylized superhero anatomy, roughly 3 heads tall, with the head about one third of the full height. Classic Spider-Man costume: red full-face mask with black web pattern, large white eye lenses bordered in black, small black spider emblem on the chest, royal blue sides and legs, red gloves and boots. Entire face covered. Standing neutral idle pose, full body visible and centered, feet on the same baseline. Authentic crisp pixel art, limited palette, discrete shading clusters, transparent background. The subject is Spider-Man himself, without any bomb, fuse, helmet, shield, Captain America star, letter A, or carried object. Preserve proper human superhero anatomy; avoid a spherical body, excessively oversized head, tiny torso or ball-shaped silhouette. Consistent costume and proportions across all eight directions.
